name: xdBot Companion
description: Android64 developer candidate: icons in the companion picker, separate in-game GDBrowser and Hyperbolus views, native local export; device tests required.

share-after-save.name: Offer to share saved macros
share-after-save.description: After a new xdBot macro file finishes saving, ask whether to open the native sharing UI. No file is sent automatically.

monitor-start.name: Show minimal monitor at level start
monitor-start.description: Display a small FPS, deaths and last-death overlay; can also be toggled in the pause menu.
